description: This Java class handles withdrawal commands for savings accounts within the Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and is annotated as a Spring Service. The class uses the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService to perform the withdrawal operation when a command is processed.

classes.name: WithdrawSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling withdrawal commands for savings accounts, delegating the withdrawal process to the corresponding platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a withdrawal command by invoking the withdrawal method on the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService with the savings ID and command details.
